{{Quote|R8, begin scanning for entry points to the cruiser.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to R8-B7 on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]]|<ref name="R2 Come Home">{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}</ref>}}
'''R8-B7''' was [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] for a brief period during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
The droid co-piloted Windu's [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor]] to [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], where Windu and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were searching for survivors at the crash site of the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] after its crash landing there.

While scouting out the terrain surrounding the wreckage along with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], R8-B7 was cornered and attacked by two of the planet's native [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]]. R2-D2 attempted to save the hapless R8-B7 but was knocked out of the fray. Following R8-B7's destruction, R2-D2 flew Windu's Delta-7B offworld to inform the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] of Skywalker and Windu's situation on Vanqor.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Because R8-B7 is named as an [[R8-series astromech droid]], which were first manufactured in the late stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and also look visually different. This sets up a [[canon]]ical ambiguity identical to that raised by the units [[R7-A7/Legends|R7-A7]] and [[R7-D4/Legends|R7-D4]].

Alternately, [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s revelation that droid names are fragments of longer designations could also provide an explanation for this apparent lack of continuity.<ref name="SWI">[[Star Wars Insider 58|''Star Wars Insider'' 58]]</ref>
